selected_option: Simple Nginx return-based 301 redirect preserving path and query string exactly once
researcher_rationale: Simplest directive form that satisfies path/query preservation without introducing rewrite-regex complexity not justified by the known GET/HEAD-only route set
limitations: Exact directive syntax (return vs location-regex capture) not finalized; non-GET behavior separately reviewed; syntax not yet tested in a disposable configuration
dependencies: Disposable rehearsal must pass before candidate diff is drafted
production_impact: No current production change -- redirect not implemented
rollback_requirement: Full silida.conf backup and nginx -t validation required before any reload
notes: Safeguards required: no open redirect; no /atlas/atlas/ duplication; no /westkust/westkust/ duplication; no query-string duplication

selected_option: Do not preserve /westkust/ as a long-term static application path; redirect legacy static-asset requests only after compatibility testing proves asset loading remains correct
researcher_rationale: Avoids permanently dual-serving static assets while not redirecting assets before compatibility is proven
limitations: Compatibility testing not yet performed; no mixed /atlas/ page plus /westkust/ asset dependency may exist at execution time
dependencies: RETIRE-CAND static-asset smoke tests must pass before this decision converts to execution
production_impact: No current production change -- static asset routing unchanged
rollback_requirement: Rollback to dual-serving if any asset compatibility test fails
notes: Global replacement of the word westkust is out of scope; repository, service, hostname, filesystem, and historical identifiers are preserved unless they are active public URL references

decision_topic: Observation period after future production activation
selected_option: 30-day observation period with review points at Day 0/1/7/14/30
researcher_rationale: Matches researcher's own recommended duration; review points give early detection (Day 0/1) plus sustained-traffic confirmation (Day 7/14/30) before considering the redirect settled
limitations: Applies only after production execution is separately authorized; this decision does not itself authorize execution
dependencies: Production execution decision (ROUTE-IMPL-DEC-05) must be separately approved first
production_impact: No current production change -- no redirect is active to observe yet
rollback_requirement: No rollback action defined by this decision alone; rollback trigger conditions are recorded under ROUTE-IMPL-DEC-05 preconditions
notes: Monitor: legacy route traffic; deep-link distribution; redirect status; loops; 404 results; asset failures; query preservation; authentication consequences

selected_option: Defer full SEO infrastructure to a separate milestone
researcher_rationale: No canonical-link/sitemap/robots mechanism exists in the application today (confirmed absent by discovery); building this infrastructure is a distinct workstream from the redirect itself
limitations: Deferred scope explicitly excludes sitemap implementation, robots infrastructure, full canonical metadata system, search-console integration, and automated SEO pipeline
dependencies: None blocking the redirect decision; this deferral does not block ROUTE-IMPL-DEC-01/02/03
production_impact: No current production change -- no SEO infrastructure exists or is being added
rollback_requirement: Not applicable -- no change is made under this decision
notes: Required future direction once undertaken: public navigation uses /atlas/; /atlas/ is canonical; /westkust/ is not canonical; protected research routes remain outside public sitemap

selected_option: Do not authorize production execution at this time
researcher_rationale: No candidate production diff exists yet; disposable rehearsal, static-path validation, and non-GET review have not been performed; execution authorization is reserved for a separate, explicitly authorized future turn
limitations: Execution remains blocked until all listed preconditions are satisfied
dependencies: Exact production candidate diff; disposable redirect rehearsal pass; static path validation; non-GET behavior review; backup and rollback completion; approved maintenance window; recorded operator and rollback authority; approved production smoke and negative tests; no unrelated production diff present
production_impact: No current production change -- production Nginx, source, and API behavior all unchanged
rollback_requirement: Full rollback runbook (silida.conf backup restore, nginx -t, reload) must be complete and rehearsed before execution is authorized
notes: This is the governing decision -- ROUTE-IMPL-DEC-01/02/03/04 are design/planning decisions only and none imply execution authorization

selected_option: Do not bundle route retirement with Basic Auth implementation
researcher_rationale: Keeping the two changes on independent authorization tracks limits blast radius per change and avoids conflating a routing change with an authentication change
limitations: None -- this is a sequencing decision, not a technical limitation
dependencies: Required sequence: R1 route retirement redirect (stop and validate) -> R2 N1 port containment (stop and validate) -> R3 Basic Auth for protected /atlas/ pages and both research APIs (stop and validate)
production_impact: No current production change -- Basic Auth remains not implemented, unaffected by this decision
rollback_requirement: Not applicable -- no change is made under this decision
notes: Each stage (R1/R2/R3) requires its own separate validation and authorization before the next stage proceeds
